title: Use multimodal models for images · Level 1
slo: Explain how a multimodal model can use an image and text together.

exercises.question_text: What does a vision-enabled GPT model combine?

options.rationale: Vision-enabled GPT models interpret visual input. They respond in natural language.
Editing and remixing are media-generation activities. They do not define GPT with vision.
options.better_fit: Use this for image editing or video-remix capabilities.

options.rationale: Object detection is a narrow vision task. GPT with vision supports broader visual reasoning and language responses.
options.better_fit: Use this when only object identification is needed.

options.rationale: Text-only generation does not process visual input. Vision-enabled GPT combines visual understanding with language responses.
options.better_fit: Use this when no image or other visual input is involved.

exercises.explanation: Correct. GPT with vision combines visual understanding and language.

exercises.question_text: Which data types can a multimodal model work with at the same time? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Text is a supported multimodal data type. It can be combined with other input types.
Images are a supported multimodal data type. They can be considered with written input.
Audio is another data type multimodal models can work with. Multimodal means more than one type of data.
Multimodal models are not restricted to image pixels. They work across multiple input types.
options.better_fit: Use this for an image-only processing task.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Multimodal models work with multiple data types.

exercises.question_text: A vision-enabled GPT model can understand images but cannot give natural-language responses.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A suitable model would be ruled out.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Vision-enabled GPT combines image understanding with natural-language responses.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Natural-language responses are part of GPT with vision.

exercises.question_text: A multimodal model can use an image and text together to answer a question about a photo.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: One input would be left out.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Multimodal models combine more than one type of data.

exercises.explanation: Correct. It can combine the photo and written question.

options.text: An Azure platform for enterprise AI work
options.rationale: Microsoft Foundry is an Azure platform for enterprise AI operations and application development. It includes a model catalog and broader development capabilities.

options.text: A screen for testing deployed models
options.rationale: This describes a playground rather than the full platform. A playground is one place for interactive testing.
options.better_fit: Use this for a question about testing a deployed model interactively.

options.rationale: An API is a code interface for sending requests. Foundry is the Azure platform that organizes enterprise AI work.
options.better_fit: Use this when code must send a model request.

options.rationale: An image-generation model is a specific AI capability. Foundry is the platform used to develop and operate AI applications.
options.better_fit: Use this when the task specifically requires creating or editing images.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Foundry is the broader Azure platform.

exercises.question_text: Which are examples of AI applications or agents using visual input? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Agents can review screenshots to inform decisions. This uses supplied visual input.

options.text: A support app analyzing customer photos
options.rationale: Support applications can analyze customer photos. This can improve a user workflow.

options.text: A learning tool explaining a chart
options.rationale: Learning tools can interpret charts or diagrams. They can explain that visual material in plain language.

options.text: A tool generating only video clips
options.rationale: Video generation creates content rather than understanding supplied content. It does not describe the listed visual-input uses.
options.better_fit: Use this when the goal is to create original video.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Each example uses visual input to help a person or decision.

exercises.question_text: Microsoft Foundry is only a playground for testing models.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: This narrows a platform to one testing activity.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Foundry supports enterprise AI operations and application development.

exercises.explanation: Correct. The playground is only one part of Foundry.

exercises.question_text: A learning tool can use visual input to explain diagrams or charts in plain language.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A useful learning workflow would be overlooked.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Visual input can help a learning tool explain diagrams and charts.

exercises.explanation: Correct. This is a useful image-understanding application.

exercises.question_text: Which GPT-4.1 family models are general-purpose multimodal models? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: GPT-4.1 is a listed general-purpose multimodal model. It processes text and images together.
GPT-4.1-mini is a listed general-purpose multimodal model. It supports combined text-and-image tasks.
GPT-4.1-nano is a listed general-purpose multimodal model. It can process text and images together.

options.error_type: Confuses video model with GPT family
options.rationale: Sora is associated with video generation. It is not a GPT-4.1 family model.
options.better_fit: Use this when the task is generating a video.

exercises.explanation: Correct. All three GPT-4.1 variants are listed multimodal choices.

options.text: Interpreting visual input and giving an informed response
options.rationale: Visual reasoning interprets what is visible. It produces an informed response, often in natural language.

options.text: Drawing a new image from text
options.rationale: Text-to-image generation creates new visual output. Visual reasoning interprets existing visual input.
options.better_fit: Use this when a description must become an image.

options.rationale: Object detection is a specific visual task. Visual reasoning can interpret broader visual meaning.
options.better_fit: Use this when the task is limited to identifying objects.

options.rationale: Image segmentation separates an image into regions. Visual reasoning interprets the visual information to form an informed response.
options.better_fit: Use this when image regions must be identified or separated.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Visual reasoning interprets visual meaning and responds.

exercises.question_text: Foundry's catalog includes partner models that support text and image understanding.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Suitable partner choices could be overlooked.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Foundry includes Microsoft and partner models that support text and image understanding.

exercises.explanation: Correct. The catalog includes partner-provided multimodal choices.

exercises.question_text: Using text and image inputs together always requires separate vision pipelines.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The team could add unnecessary processing steps.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: A model that accepts text and images together can simplify an end-to-end workflow.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Combined-input models can reduce the need for separate pipelines.

flashcards.back: An Azure platform for enterprise AI operations and application development.
A model that works with multiple data types together.
A model that understands visuals and replies in natural language.
Interpreting visual input and giving an informed response.
